quotes.text: I would give this tour, and particularly our guide Shaun, 5.5 stars if I could. What a fantastic ride this was! It was easy to get set up and onto the waverunner, getting in and out of the water was smooth, and from the minute you can open those things up it's a thrilling and relaxing ride. Plenty of picture taking opportunities, cool trails to zip through, all topped off by a stop on a brand new beach tucked behind the main shoreline made for a pretty perfect day. Highly recommended!!

the most fun i’ve ever had! Shawn was an amazing guide and i would recommend this tour for everyone. I am 15 and i got to drive my own because they helped me 2 find a link in order to get a temporary boating certificate.
Sean was an awesome guide and everyone was so friendly!! This was my first time and they had us up and going in no time. Highly recommend!
